entries.title: SlangPy tests now run via cross-repo dispatch
entries.body: SlangPy integration tests are now triggered automatically on every Slang PR via cross-repository dispatch to the SlangPy repository. Tests run against SlangPy tip-of-tree (Linux + Windows Release). The 'SlangPy Tests' commit status is a required check for merging. Debug and macOS coverage continues via nightly runs.
entries.author: jkiviluoto-nv
